title: Continuous modelling: folding it into refinement and design review

videos.script: Most threat models die quietly. Nobody deletes them. They just stop changing while the system keeps going. {{quiet}} Six weeks in, the clinic's model is still alive. But a supplier's report found two threats it had missed. {{missed}} And a review date slipped by a week before anybody noticed. {{slipped}} Today you fold the model into the work the team already does. A few questions in refinement. A short review when a design changes. {{fold}} Then you make the model check itself, on every change and every Monday. {{check}} It fails, on purpose, the first time you run it. {{fails}} And you choose the few numbers that tell you whether the model is still alive. {{alive}}
